zai-org/GLM-5.3.description: Recommended - Zhipu's flagship GLM-5.3, the only model in this roster that was live capability-probed end to end: a real structured tool call (finish_reason=tool_calls, 9 tool_calls deltas under streaming), SSE streaming (62 events, terminal [DONE]), and json_object structured output. A heavy internal reasoner exposed via reasoning/reasoning_content — at a small max_tokens budget the whole completion is spent on unfinished reasoning before any visible content, so give it a generous max_tokens. Rejects image/video input and rejects tools+response_format together, both HTTP 422 (see capabilities.structuredOutputWithTools). maxOutputTokens is the documented per-request output ceiling from https://friendli.ai/docs/examples/models/zai-glm-5-3/overview.md (retrieved 2026-09-09) — 131,072 tokens, distinct from the 1,048,576-token context window; the authenticated roster's max_completion_tokens field reports 1048576 (equal to context) but that is not treated as the output cap. Pricing per the same page: $1.40 / $4.40 per MTok input/output, $0.26 per MTok cached input.

authProbe.method: POST /chat/completions with an invalid API key

liveMatrix.result: Probed against the default model, zai-org/GLM-5.3, via https://api.friendli.ai/serverless/v1. The first probe run used a 2s cadence, tripped Friendli's rate limit (12/16 cases 429) and is discarded entirely; this result is from a slower-paced re-run plus targeted single-call re-probes, each still hitting 429 occasionally even at ~25s spacing — Friendli's rate limits are tight, so any future live check needs generous pacing (20s+) and retry. Roster: GET /serverless/v1/models returns 200 with exactly 7 ids, all zai-org GLM family plus google/gemma-4-31B-it, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.2 and MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.5 — models.fallbacks lists all 7. Wire mechanics on GLM-5.3: chat, system role, array content parts (message content IS accepted as a parts array, so no messageContentFormat quirk is declared), sampling params and max_completion_tokens all 200. Streaming: SSE, 200, 62 events, terminal [DONE] present — contentDeltas were 0 only because GLM-5.3 is a heavy reasoner that spent the small test budget entirely on reasoning/reasoning_content fields, not because streaming is broken. Tool calling: a real structured tool_call (get_time, tz argument parsed, finish_reason=tool_calls) on the first turn, a null-content assistant tool_calls turn accepted on replay, and 9 tool_calls deltas surfacing mid-SSE-stream — tools and toolsWithStreaming true; tool_choice is tolerated even with no tools declared. response_format json_object returns 200 cleanly — structuredOutput true. response_format json_schema also returns 200, but at the tested token budget the content is unfinished reasoning text rather than schema-conformant JSON — same reasoning-budget effect as above; NeuroLink's coerceJsonToSchema repair layer is the intended safety net. Sending tools and a JSON schema together in the same request is a genuine, hard rejection: HTTP 422 'The 'response_format' field cannot be set when tools are specified' — the same class of vendor exclusivity NeuroLink already handles generically for Groq via isToolsSchemaConflictError (pattern-matches the response_format+tool wording in the thrown error and retries the call without response_format), so no provider-specific quirk was added — structuredOutputWithTools is declared false. Vision: a real image part returns HTTP 422 'This model does not support image/video inputs.' — genuinely unsupported, not a rate limit; no model in this roster is marked vision:true and models.visionModel is left unset. Error shapes: bad key -> 401 {"detail":"Unauthorized. Please provide a valid credential."}; bad model -> 404 {"detail":"Model '<id>' not found."}. Only zai-org/GLM-5.3 (the declared default) was capability-probed end to end under the account's tight rate limit; the other 6 roster ids are roster-verified by id only, matching the account's usable request budget for this pass.
